facts.text: ARC Prize announced Lohit Siriki as the third-place qualifying open-source ARC-AGI-3 Milestone 2 prize winner on October 1, 2026.
Lohit Siriki's public Kaggle profile, handle sirikilohit and display name rellik13, lists the job title Machine Learning Engineer and dates the account to September 2022.

Kaggle lists Lohit Siriki's completed AI Agent Security - Multi-Step Tool Attacks entry 3,333rd of 4,186 teams and the completed RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection entry 3,354th of 6,299 teams, with no medal shown on either row.
The Kaggle record also holds two 2022 PES University course contests, UE20CS312 Data Analytics (162nd of 177, shown with four accounts) and UE20CS344 Network Analysis and Mining (168th of 394).
On October 30, 2026 Kaggle listed ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3 and the Google Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition as the two competitions the profile was still active in.

teamNotes: The Kaggle display name rellik13 matches the team name in the repo's dated ARC-AGI-3 and ARC-AGI-2 public roster observations for sirikilohit (team ids 16706087 and 16779554). The competition rows on the profile show only account handles, not team names, so no teamName is recorded for any completed result. Only the Data Analytics (UE20CS312) row shows more than one account. No medal is credited to this person, and no team medal is claimed. No public ARC standing is quoted here; any ARC-AGI-3 rank for rellik13 is provisional until the private leaderboard settles at the November 2 close.
